notes: The session's web search allowance ran out after 16 of the 29 candidates, so Pendleton, Foster, Dreier, Geiser, Tomko, Kroll, Trickey, Wrobley and the sitting members were researched only from pages reachable by a known address. Not recorded because the site could not be opened and read: justingeiser.com (refused the kit's fetch) and jennifertrickeyformissouri.com (its text is drawn by script). The Missouri House Democrats' page lists candidates and does not say it endorses them, so no endorsement is recorded. Chastidy Dillon-Amelung's 2024 appointment was seen only in search summaries (the Governor's release answered 404, the courts page 403), so it is left out.
